tests.title: integration: auto-ingest orchestrator (prod-layout trackers, stubbed Bedrock + Comprehend) clean tracker: every row is matched, categorized and auto-inserted exactly once with consistent amounts
integration: auto-ingest orchestrator (prod-layout trackers, stubbed Bedrock + Comprehend) re-uploading the identical tracker is rejected as a duplicate file (nothing inserted)
integration: auto-ingest orchestrator (prod-layout trackers, stubbed Bedrock + Comprehend) a cumulative re-upload skips the rows already ingested and inserts only the new ones
integration: auto-ingest orchestrator (prod-layout trackers, stubbed Bedrock + Comprehend) two concurrent orchestrator runs over the same entries insert each transaction exactly once
integration: auto-ingest orchestrator (prod-layout trackers, stubbed Bedrock + Comprehend) the is_processed claim guard skips (never double-inserts or downgrades) an entry processed after it was read
integration: auto-ingest orchestrator (prod-layout trackers, stubbed Bedrock + Comprehend) internal customers (INTERNAL_CUSTOMER_IDS) are auto-inserted NON-billable with hours still recorded
integration: auto-ingest orchestrator (prod-layout trackers, stubbed Bedrock + Comprehend) mixed tracker: ambiguous customers, missing jobs, vague notes and non-work rows are handled per row
